import com.webcommander.sdk.client.ApiResponse;
import java.util.Map;
import static java.util.Map.entry;

ApiResponse response = client.discountProfiles().createDiscountProfile(Map.ofEntries(
        entry("name", "Spring 40 Off"), entry("type", "offer_coupon"), entry("discount_details_type", "amount"),
        entry("amount_details", Map.of("type", "single", "apply_to", "total_order", "single_amount", 40,
                "single_amount_type", "PERCENT")),
        entry("is_active", true), entry("start_date", "2026-11-06 09:30:00"), entry("is_specify_end_date", true),
        entry("end_date", "2026-11-16 18:00:00"), entry("is_apply_coupon_code", true),
        entry("default_coupon_code", "SPRING40"), entry("is_maximum_use_total", true), entry("maximum_use_count", 100),
        entry("is_maximum_use_customer", true), entry("maximum_use_customer_count", 1),
        entry("is_maximum_discount_allowed", true), entry("maximum_discount_allowed_amount", 200),
        entry("is_display_text_coupon", true), entry("display_text_coupon", "Use code SPRING40 at checkout"),
        entry("is_display_text_cart", true), entry("display_text_cart", "Spring sale discount applied"),
        entry("is_display_text_partial_discount_condition", true),
        entry("display_text_partial_discount_condition", "Add one more item to get the spring discount")));
System.out.println(((Map<?, ?>) ((Map<?, ?>) response.getMap()).get("discount_profile")).get("id"));
